wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the flaw is unbounded resource use inside parsers, not object-level authorization; no neighbouring or proxy resource exists to authorise
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the library has no roles, peers or directions; every route reads a file supplied by the caller
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every entry point is a read; there is no write verb on the same sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity is parsed or compared on the protected path
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the bound does not depend on an authority, secret or role lookup

traps.shape: unbounded decompression: a gzip-compressed workbook is inflated into memory with no decoded-size bound
traps.realistic_because: the advisory route: the only gzdecode() call in the tree, reached by all four Gnumeric entry points

traps.shape: cyclic sector chain: the SSAT chain walk revisits a block forever
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the same container parser the Xls reader uses

traps.shape: cyclic small-stream chain in getStream, reached only after read() returns
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; a guard added only to the read() chain leaves it open

traps.shape: cyclic big-stream chain in getStream, although a block count is computed just above the loop
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the declared-size block count makes the loop look bounded

traps.shape: cyclic directory chain in readData, reached from read() and again from every small-stream getStream
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; readData is re-walked once per small stream, so the guard must be per chain

traps.shape: second implementation of the same sector-chain walk, in the public container class, with cyclic links
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; no Reader calls this class, so it looks like legacy write-side code outside the advisory

traps.shape: second decompression implementation: archive entries are inflated whole, with no uncompressed-size bound
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; a different container and compression primitive, which the advisory never names

A.summary: resource exhaustion when reading untrusted workbooks: unbounded gzip expansion in the Gnumeric reader and unbounded OLE sector-chain walks
